conversation_starters.title: City Council approves $60 million purchase of land for new Spurs arena and OKs Midtown TIRZ extension—with a catch
conversation_starters.summary: San Antonio's City Council took up a 19-year extension of the Midtown TIRZ, a tax increment reinvestment zone that sets aside growth in property tax dollars to pay for specific projects in that area, pushing it out to 2060. Mayor Jones came out against the extension on the eve of the vote, but the Council approved it anyway, along with a $60 million land purchase for a new Spurs arena. Councilman Edward Mungia led a change that leaves the Council room to sunset the zone earlier than 2060.
conversation_starters.description: San Antonio leaders approved extending the Midtown TIRZ to 2060, though Councilman Edward Mungia led a change that gives leaders flexibility in sunsetting it early.
questions: Have you been following the plans for the new Spurs arena?
What are people around San Antonio saying about what the arena would mean for the Midtown area?
